changes.summary: Persist bounded identity-bound startup wait snapshots, renew pre-readiness inactivity only from exact process activity without granting readiness, and retain backward-readable lifecycle v4-v5, Artifact v11-v12 and Planning v14-v15 records
Disable the optional implicit OpenClaw memory slot for controlled Planning and runtime Agents while preserving isolated sessions, typed submission, and the default context engine
Collect independent criterion relation failures into one identity-bound correction while preserving prerequisite ordering and strict revalidation
Continue an ordinary targeted correction only when its typed issue set strictly shrinks, narrowing the next request to unresolved siblings while unchanged remainders stop
Apply any nonempty subset of unique authorized correction slots to an unpublished copy, preserve omissions exactly, and continue only after complete revalidation proves typed progress

Let one focused Planning question declare tightly coupled ProductDefinition dimensions, project exact transcript answers into statement fields, and return undeclared or ambiguous values to focused clarification
Classify absolute-guarantee Review boundary omissions as typed criterion siblings so prior corrections can expose and repair every exact leaf without falling back to root authority
Bind targeted relation corrections to canonical immutable requirement, criterion, decision, Agent and task IDs while preserving jointly created identities
Check durable cancellation and interruption before initial, correction, fallback and continuation calls instead of relying only on currently live subprocesses
Classify invalid correction submissions as model errors and retain verified catalog bindings only through a strictly shrinking unpublished selection state before full grounding
Own and revalidate the private runtime compile cache, neutralize ambient cache selectors, and refresh legacy launchers without adopting shared Node cache state
Return planning and targeted correction values to controller validation once, and persist interrupted or failed planning invocations with exact settlement and backward-readable lifecycle evidence
Project persisted invocation state, detailed labels and visibility-aware heartbeats from the current checkpoint while retaining canonical historical events and distinct scheduler decisions
Preserve pinned-runtime unknown-tool rejections as provenance-bound negative diagnostics without inventing execution evidence or invalidating independent paired tool work
Persist settled shared-ledger records in versioned planning turns so pre-runtime failures retain independently auditable cache usage and frozen prices
Distinguish model-authored citation errors from missing user decisions and correct only attributable source leaves without widening authorization
Preserve per-invariant user authority and return a rejected proposal to one atomic question-only Planning response instead of attempting to model-correct a missing user decision
Persist terminally invalid initial Planning as failed and restore the preceding valid proposal after a completed invalid revision without masking executor terminal states
Grant atomic ProductDefinition fields and their required shared decision relation together while preserving narrower correction when an eligible decision already exists
Freeze cache read/write rates and account disjoint usage across planning, execution, budgets and reports while preserving historical records
Explain intentional detached HEAD and immutable input ancestry to revision writers without weakening the independent safety gate
Interactive requirements and approved dynamic agent plans, with explicit prototype and usable-product acceptance
Per-agent progress, user steering and lifecycle controls, model routing, USD budgets and activity-based liveness
Controller-bound corrections, tool continuation, isolated validation, read-only review and auditable runnable delivery
Pre-task self-check, isolated OpenClaw ownership, versioned stable/dev installation, updates, rollback, export and preservation-aware uninstall
Supervised offline validation with resource and cleanup evidence, exact-tag release gating and immutable release identity
Same-source channel and ref switches preserve distinct immutable installation identities and reuse compatible historical paths without relocation
Serialize observer publication through the lifecycle stop authority so late session history cannot reopen working progress during shutdown
Classify literal directory-wrapper activity without exposing arguments or changing direct-executable evidence authority
Own checksum-verified private runtime setup with shared Node and OpenClaw pins, isolated npm and runtime environments, and no upstream Gateway lifecycle
